book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 显然 $x_i\in(0,1)$, 由柯西不等式和平均值不等式, 有 $\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{x_k}{x_{k+1}-x_{k+1}^2}=\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{x_k}{x_{k+1}(1-x_k)}\geqslant\frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}(2^n-1)<3n^2\cdot2^n$. 因为 $n\geqslant4$, 故 $n^2>3n$, $n^2\geqslant3n+1$, 进而 $3n^2\geqslant2n^2+3n+1$. 所以 $(2n^2+3n+1)(2^n-1)<3n^2\cdot2^n$. 从而, 命题成立.
original_text_md: 15. 显然 $x_i\in(0,1)$, 由柯西不等式和平均值不等式, 有 $\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{x_k}{x_{k+1}-x_{k+1}^2}=\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{x_k}{x_{k+1}(1-x_k)}\geqslant\frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}(2^n-1)<3n^2\cdot2^n$. 因为 $n\geqslant4$, 故 $n^2>3n$, $n^2\geqslant3n+1$, 进而 $3n^2\geqslant2n^2+3n+1$. 所以 $(2n^2+3n+1)(2^n-1)<3n^2\cdot2^n$. 从而, 命题成立.
